ayres: He had fallen on his feet in Buenos Ayres, he said, and had come over to the old country just for a holiday.
Beaufort sent her over from Buenos Ayres to the Assomption.
She was to go away with him by the night-boat to be his wife and to live with him in Buenos Ayres where he had a home waiting for her.
If she went, tomorrow she would be on the sea with Frank, steaming towards Buenos Ayres.

He was subsequently heard of in Constantinople, then in Russia; and a dozen years later American travellers were handsomely entertained by him in Buenos Ayres, where he represented a large insurance agency.
